caption_used: 该柱状图展示了2022年7月1日至8月26日期间全球每日新增新冠确诊病例数量与相关新闻媒体报道数量的变化趋势。蓝绿色柱状图表示当日确诊病例数，蓝色折线图表示新闻报道数量。整体来看，新闻报道数量在7月中旬达到峰值约4,200篇，随后呈现持续下降趋势；而确诊病例数在8月初出现明显高峰，单日最高超过1,200,000例。值得注意的是，两条数据序列在整个观测期间始终保持高度同步的正相关波动，未出现显著的时间滞后效应。
raw_response: DESCRIPTION:The figure presents a clustered column chart illustrating the daily new confirmed COVID-19 cases and related news media reports from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022. The horizontal axis represents dates, ranging from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with evenly spaced daily intervals. The vertical axis on the left represents the number of new cases, labeled as "每日新增患者人数," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1,800,000. The vertical axis on the right represents the number of news media reports, labeled as "新闻媒体报道数量," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6,000. The chart features a series of blue-green columns representing the daily confirmed cases. The shortest column has a value of approximately 60,000, while the tallest column reaches approximately 1,200,000. A blue line overlays the columns, representing the number of news media reports. The line fluctuates between approximately 1,000 and 4,200 reports. The columns are arranged chronologically, following the date sequence on the horizontal axis. A legend in the bottom right corner identifies the blue-green columns as "该日全球确诊数量" (daily global confirmed cases) and the blue line as "有关covid-19新闻数量" (related COVID-19 news reports).
